lidar: USGS CO_DRCOG_2_2020 (https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/CO_DRCOG_2_2020/ept.json), classes 2 (ground) and 17 (bridge deck), through tools/lidar_connector_profile.py's tile cache and reader
_doc: Item 1 (ledgers 0079 round R item 4, 0098): Colorado Blvd (lap v3205 -> v140) and the lap's Quebec St (v1940 -> v2080) off the 2020 lidar, every 2.5 m of the lap's s (s_lap: plan metres along centerline.local.json from v0; run_m: from the stretch's first station; v: the lap vertex at or before it). built: the lap's widths_m, centred (left_u_m = +w/2, right_u_m = -w/2). faces: right_edge, median_near, median_far, left_edge (a station that is not divided has right_edge and left_edge, its far-face candidates under not_divided_candidates), each {u_m: + = left of travel, kind: curb | drop | fall | none (outer edges; a median face is curb | none), step_m (curb / drop: up / down outward; a median face: onto the median), y_minus_side / y_plus_side (the two side lines read at the face, heights in the lap's y), grade_inward_side / grade_outward_side, returns, real_minus_built_m (u minus the built edge on that side)}. A `none` face's u is where the trace ran, not a measurement. median: {near_face_u_m, far_face_u_m, width_m (face to face), top_y, top_over_near_side_m / top_over_far_side_m}; carriageways: near_m / far_m (divided) or one_m; real_width_m: outer edge to outer edge (both measured); per_50m: median / min / max / n. Method and every [invented] constant: roads_lidar_g10.py.
frame: the lap's: ENU local metres about centerline.local.json's origin (X east, Z north); heights = las z - origin.elev_m, the lap's y; +u = left of the lap's travel
